sourceFile: 61. BRS-201506 Report checking Gauss SPK date 12.7.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable Gauss evidence but the primary changed factor and outcome grouping are not verified.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not an evidence-based condition.
Baseline/test conditions are marked non-explicit despite OK vs NG headers.
Outcomes are duplicated and split by detected columns instead of one report context.
Some stats cite header rows rather than full data rows.
Spec compliance is unreliable where values appear outside stated Grill spec.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor from source headers, likely OK hearing-voltage-up vs NG voltage-standard if supported.
Use sheet/date/type/sample grouping keys from full data rows.
Merge Gauss final SPK, Yoke, Grill, and GAP results under one validation report context.
Cite actual measurement rows plus header/spec rows, not headers alone.
Recalculate spec violations against stated Yoke and Grill limits.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient for final evidence until data rows and grouping are cited.
